  "title": "Chief Compliance Officer",
  "description": "Tokiye Integrated Medical Service was created to address the critical needs in healthcare project management with an emphasis on effective and efficient service delivery. The company is driven by a passion for excellence and a commitment to professional service, aiming to elevate Nigeria&rsquo;s healthcare system to international standards.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Chief Compliance Officer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Job type: Full time

Job Description


	To lead the Bank&#39;s compliance function and ensure that its operations, products, services and business activities remain compliant with applicable laws, regulations, regulatory directives and internal policies.
	The Chief Compliance Officer will provide independent compliance oversight, with particular responsibility for regulatory compliance, AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence, sanctions screening and regulatory reporting, helping to protect the Bank&#39;s license, reputation and financial integrity.


Key Responsibilities
Compliance Framework and Regulatory Governance:


	Develop, maintain and continuously improve the Bank&#39;s compliance framework, policies, procedures and regulatory obligations register.
	Monitor changes in applicable laws, regulations, CBN directives, NDIC requirements and other regulatory expectations and advise Management on their implications.
	Conduct periodic compliance assessments across the Bank&#39;s business and operational functions.
	Identify regulatory compliance gaps and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
	Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence of compliance activities.
	Provide independent compliance advice to Management and the Board on material regulatory matters.


AML/CFT and Financial Crime Compliance:


	Lead the Bank&#39;s AML/CFT compliance framework in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
	Establish and maintain appropriate controls for identifying, assessing and managing money-laundering and terrorist-financing risks.
	Oversee transaction monitoring and ensure unusual and potentially suspicious activities are appropriately reviewed and escalated.
	Coordinate the investigation and reporting of suspicious transactions and other reportable activities to the appropriate authorities.
	Maintain appropriate AML/CFT records, documentation and reporting processes.
	Monitor the effectiveness of the Bank&#39;s financial crime controls and recommend enhancements where required.


KYC and Customer Due Diligence:


	Establish and enforce appropriate customer identification and verification standards.
	Oversee the Bank&#39;s KYC and customer due diligence framework across all customer segments and channels.
	Ensure enhanced due diligence is applied to higher-risk customers, relationships and transactions.
	Monitor the completeness, accuracy and currency of customer information and documentation.
	Conduct periodic reviews of customer risk classifications and due diligence requirements.
	Work with Operations, Business and Risk to address KYC deficiencies promptly.


Sanctions, PEP and Screening Controls:


	Oversee sanctions, politically exposed persons and other relevant customer screening processes.
	Ensure appropriate escalation and investigation of potential screening matches.
	Maintain effective procedures for reviewing and resolving sanctions and PEP alerts.
	Monitor the effectiveness of screening systems and controls.
	Ensure compliance with applicable sanctions and regulatory requirements.


Regulatory Reporting and Liaison


	Prepare, review and coordinate timely submission of compliance-related regulatory returns and reports.
	Maintain a regulatory reporting calendar and ensure all compliance submissions are completed within prescribed timelines.
	Serve as a principal compliance contact for regulators, working alongside the MD/CEO and other relevant executives.
	Coordinate responses to regulatory enquiries relating to compliance and AML/CFT matters.
	Support regulatory examinations and ensure identified compliance issues are appropriately addressed.


Compliance Monitoring and Testing:


	Develop and implement a risk-based compliance monitoring programme.
	Conduct periodic reviews and testing of business processes, customer files, transactions and regulatory controls.
	Identify compliance breaches, control deficiencies and emerging regulatory risks.
	Escalate material compliance issues to Management and, where appropriate, the Board.
	Track remediation of compliance findings to closure.
	Maintain an appropriate record of compliance incidents, breaches and corrective actions.


Compliance Training and Awareness


	Develop and deliver regular compliance, AML/CFT and regulatory training programmes for employees.
	Ensure employees understand their responsibilities regarding KYC, AML/CFT, sanctions, customer protection and regulatory compliance.
	Maintain training records and monitor completion rates.
	Provide targeted training where specific compliance weaknesses or regulatory changes are identified.
	Promote a culture of regulatory compliance and ethical conduct throughout the Bank.


Product and Business Advisory:


	Advise Management and business functions on the regulatory implications of new products, services, digital channels and partnerships.
	Review proposed products, customer journeys and third-party arrangements from a compliance perspective.
	Participate in relevant product and technology development processes to ensure compliance considerations are incorporated from inception.
	Provide practical recommendations for managing regulatory risks without unnecessarily restricting legitimate business activities.


Management and Board Reporting:


	Provide regular compliance reports to the MD/CEO and relevant Board committees.
	Report significant compliance breaches, AML/CFT risks, regulatory developments and unresolved issues promptly.
	Present compliance trends, monitoring results and remediation status to Management and the Board.
	Provide recommendations for strengthening the Bank&#39;s compliance environment


Requirements


	First Degree in Law, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Banking, Business Administration or another relevant discipline.
	Professional certification in compliance or AML/CFT, such as CAMS or an equivalent recognised certification, is desirable.
	CIBN membership or relevant professional banking certification is an advantage.
	A relevant postgraduate qualification is an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience, with at least 3 years in a senior compliance, regulatory, AML/CFT or financial crime role within financial services.
	Experience in a Microfinance Bank, commercial bank, fintech, payments institution or other regulated financial institution is strongly preferred.
	Demonstrable experience in AML/CFT, KYC, transaction monitoring, regulatory reporting and regulatory examinations is required.


Core Competencies:


	AML/CFT and financial crime compliance
	KYC and customer due diligence
	Transaction monitoring and investigations
	Sanctions and PEP screening
	Regulatory interpretation
	Compliance monitoring and testing
	Regulatory reporting
	Risk assessment and control evaluation
	Investigative rigour and attention to detail
	Regulatory stakeholder management
	Ethical judgement and professional integrity
	Clear communication and advisory skills


Performance Measures:


	Timely and accurate submission of regulatory and AML/CFT-related reports.
	Effective KYC and customer due diligence compliance across the customer base.
	Timely identification, investigation and escalation of suspicious activities.
	Completion and effectiveness of AML/CFT and compliance monitoring programmes.
	Compliance training completion and employee awareness levels.
	Timely closure of compliance findings and identified regulatory gaps.
	Effective management of regulatory examinations and compliance requests.
	No material regulatory sanctions attributable to preventable compliance failures.
	Effective implementation and continuous improvement of the Bank&#39;s compliance framework.

title: Job Openings at Paga Limited
content:
Paga is a licensed financial services company and a leading payments company in Nigeria with a massive transformative purpose - to make it simple for one billion people to access and use money. It was founded on the simple belief that the ubiquity of mobile phones can be leveraged in building an ecosystem that enables people to digitally send and receive money and creating simple financial access for everyone.

As part of its next phase of growth, the organization is seeking talented professionals to join it across a range of corporate and support roles, in the following capacities below:

1.) Product Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Yaba, Lagos, Nigeria
Sector: Financial Services
Reports to: Senior Product Manager or Head of Product Management
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary


	Our purpose at Paga is to make it simple for 1 billion people to access and use money. We do that by delivering innovative financial services to the mass market across large, underserved markets.
	At Paga we value above all else, Collaboration, Ownership, Results Orientation, Integrity and Innovation (CORII).
	Product development activities at Paga fall within the Product Development group, which has distinct, full-stack (from a resource perspective) teams dedicated to a functional organization unit. For example, one of the functional teams in the Product Development team is the Agent Network Team which is responsible for development and delivery of products used by the large network of financial service delivery point (agents), across the countries where Paga exists.
	As a full-stack team, this team includes project management, product management, software and database engineering, quality assurance, and UI/UX/Product-Design resources. All teams execute product development using Agile (Scrum) methodologies.
	As a Product Manager at Paga, you will individually or jointly have ownership for the success for several specific products and/or features from the set of Products that Paga delivers to its external and internal customers.


This means:


	Driving strategic decision making for the products/features within your purview and driving tactical decisions for them
	Overseeing the development of new products and features.
	Curating and growing existing products
	Generally delighting your customers (both internal and external)


At Paga, a product manager's role is both strategic and tactical. To be an effective product manager at Paga you must:


	Have good customer/market empathy to drive a consumer-centric design ethos
	Have very strong critical thinking skills to be able to translate user needs into meaningful products in a variety of diverse use cases
	Have the ability to multitask and effectively prioritize a competing number of objectives simultaneously
	Be comfortable with rapid change and be willing to take ownership to deliver results in a high-pressure product development environment
	Be able to work well in a team comprised of multiple product development skills including other product managers
	As a distributed product development team member, communication and collaboration are key.
	You will need to be excellent at utilizing remote communication tools and applying clear communication and collaboration practices to effectively engage with your “customers”, team mates and other company stakeholders.


Primary Responsibilities


	Product development activities - Executing product-development activities (ideation, specification, design, development feedback, and post-deployment product curation) for specific products and features
	Market engagement - Engaging with end-users and marketing team to refine product vision.
	Product curation - Continuously improving existing product offerings through both qualitative and quantitative analysis of product performance and product/market fit.
	Partner Engagement – Working effectively with industry/ecosystem partners to accomplish product goals


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree
	3+ years of product management or similar product development experience
	Agile product development methodology experience


Key Competencies:


	Strong strategic and critical thinking skills
	Excellent in team and cross team collaboration skills
	Great verbal/written communication skills
	Highly observant with an attentiveness to detail
	Strong multi-tasking and self-management skills
	Curious, self-driven and empathetic.


Click here to apply online

 

2.) Software Architect

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos (Hybrid)
Reports to: Lead Software Architect or Business Lead

About The Role


	As a Software Architect at Paga, you will be responsible for the technical ownership of entire products, platforms or services within the scope of Paga’s business. 
	You will be responsible for designing and delivering systems that meet all the “ities” expected of enterprise-grade, financial systems (scalability, extensibility, security, etc.).
	You will be responsible for the technical oversight of one or more teams of Software and Database Engineers, working with you to realize your product vision.


Primary Responsibilities


	Vision & Strategic Leadership – Help develop and grow the technical vision for the Paga business and engage meaningfully in the strategic development of the overall business. Engage directly in business strategic leadership when it relates to product and technical decision making.
	Broad-scoped Technical Ownership – Independently oversees all software concerns for some of the major platform areas or services. Own end-to-end responsibility for a large portion of the software system including design and implementation and including a strong knowledge of complementary engineering aspects such as data management, dev-ops and infrastructure. Own responsibility for key delivery criteria such as performance, reliability, cost, security and maintainability for large portions of the system
	Technical Leadership -- Oversees key architectural concerns such as security, scalability/performance, reliability, maintainability, and modularity. Applies a platform-wide perspective to decision making around these concerns, including infrastructural, deployment, delivery and other technically relevant concerns.
	Process Leadership -- Drive development and improvement of technical product development processes in collaborations with product development management. 
	Code Quality Review -- Provide broad-scoped yet in-depth code review for technically complex and high-impact code changes.
	Partner Engagement – Working effectively with industry/ecosystem partners to accomplish product goals.  


Knowledge and Skill Requirements


	A Degree in a related discipline 
	10+ years of continuous experience working on enterprise software application development OR an advanced degree in a related discipline and at least 8 years of continuous experience working on enterprise software application development
	While we use an increasingly diverse software stack, the following technologies and skills are most heavily used and therefore important to have some experience in:
	
		Java/J2EE and Spring and other Java frameworks
		Kafka and other stream-processing platform
		Micro-service architecture concepts
		Vue.js and React front-end frameworks
		Relational DB architecture and administration (MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL)
		Kubernetes & Docker containerization frameworks
		OLTP / Financial transaction processing concerns
		Cloud deployment architecture and concerns (Azure, AWS)
	
	


To be an effective Software Architect at Paga you must:


	Be able to quickly grasp abstract concepts and translate them into appropriately abstract or detailed software design and implementation.
	Be comfortable taking ownership for broad and important areas of enterprise software implementation.
	Be a core business resource for both technical and non-technical decision making and triage and make themselves available to this effect.
	Possess mastery over all key aspects of the frameworks and tools within your scope and have strong business-knowledge in the business functional areas you support. Have multi-functional expertise across large areas of the platform/services.
	Be comfortable in making technical decisions based on the consideration of many potential futures in decision making without knowing exactly what the future is.
	Clearly understand and effectively weigh business trade-offs in decision-making.
	Be comfortable operating at both a high and deep-dive (low) levels of abstraction.
	Be able to multitask well and be comfortable juggling multiple product-development streams at once.
	Be comfortable with rapid change and be comfortable taking ownership to   deliver results in a high-pressure product development environment.
	Have a passion for quality and an ability and willingness to grow the ability of others in your team to meet those standards. Drive quality delivery across teams with which you work. 


Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Operations Support Specialist

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos

About The Role


	The Operations Support Specialist is responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient delivery of operational processes by monitoring transactions, resolving customer and system issues, supporting incident management, performing reconciliation, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to maintain service excellence and operational efficiency.


Primary Responsibilities
Transaction Monitoring and Support:


	Monitor daily transactions across all payment channels and services.
	Investigate and resolve failed, pending, and inconclusive transactions.
	Escalate critical incidents to the appropriate teams and vendors for resolution.
	Ensure prompt resolution of customer complaints and operational issues.


Incident Management:


	Log, track, and manage incidents in accordance with established SLAs.
	Coordinate incident resolution activities with technical teams and third-party service providers.
	Prepare incident reports, root cause analyses, and post-incident reviews.
	Maintain an incident register and ensure timely updates on open issues.


Reconciliation and Settlement:


	Perform daily reconciliation of transactions across payment channels.
	Identify and investigate reconciliation exceptions and discrepancies.
	Process manual reversals and ensure accurate settlement of transactions.
	Liaise with finance and partner institutions on settlement-related matters.


Customer and Merchant Support:


	Support customer service teams in resolving transaction disputes and complaints.
	Investigate erroneous transfers, fraud reports, and chargeback requests.
	Assist merchants with transaction and account-related issues.
	Ensure timely communication and updates to stakeholders on outstanding issues.


Process and Service Monitoring:


	Monitor service availability and system performance.
	Track service metrics and prepare operational performance reports.
	Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to enhance service delivery.
	Ensure compliance with operational procedures and service standards.


Documentation and Reporting:


	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
	Maintain operational records, logs, and documentation.
	Generate SLA and KPI reports for management review.
	Document operational procedures and update process manuals as required.


Compliance and Risk Management:


	Adhere to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and operational procedures.
	Identify operational risks and recommend mitigation measures.
	Support fraud investigations and ensure appropriate controls are implemented.
	Ensure compliance with information security and data protection requirements.





Knowledge and Skill Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, Information Technology, Economics, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in Operations Support, Transaction Operations, FinTech Operations, Banking Operations, or Customer Operations.
	Relevant professional certifications in operations, service management, or project management will be an added advantage.
	ISO 20000 Service Management practices.
	ITIL Incident and Problem Management processes.
	Electronic payment systems, NIP transactions, and settlement processes.
	Jira, Service Desk, or ticket management systems.
	SQL and data analysis tools (an added advantage).
	Experience in transaction monitoring, reconciliation, incident management, and dispute resolution is highly desirable.


Key Competencies:


	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Knowledge of electronic payment systems and banking operations.
	Understanding of incident management and service management processes.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
	Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
	Ability to multitask and work under pressure.
	Good knowledge of payment channels, reconciliation processes, and fraud management.

title: Job Openings at Chowdeck
content:
Chowdeck is a food technology company that provides a food delivery hub that connects both food vendors and consumers. This allows food vendors to deliver meals seamlessly while also providing consumers with a platform to order meals from their favourite restaurants in their city. In between the consumers and vendors sits our riders who are the superstars of Chowdeck.

At Chowdeck, we unite people through innovative meal-ordering and delivery technology, putting smiles across faces and ensuring satisfaction in bellies. We empower food businesses with essentials to foster new growth horizons while creating a better standard of living for their communities.
     

            
    



As part of its next phase of growth, the organization is seeking talented professionals to join it across a range of corporate and support roles, in the following capacities below:

1.) Telesales Agent

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos

Job Description


	We're looking for an exceptional Telesales Agent to join our Strategy & Operations team.
	In this role, you'll engage customers through outbound calls and other channels to drive customer engagement, generate orders, and support growth initiatives. You'll work closely with the Data and Operations teams to execute campaigns, understand customer needs, and deliver measurable outcomes.
	This is a fast-paced, target-driven role suited to someone who is confident communicating with customers, commercially minded, and motivated by measurable results.
	This is an in-person role. You will be required to work from our Ikoyi office on a full-time basis.


In this role, you'll be required to:


	Make outbound calls to assigned customer segments and campaigns.
	Engage customers to drive orders, product adoption, and overall customer growth.
	Communicate relevant promotions and offers while handling objections effectively.
	Follow up with customers and maintain accurate records of interactions and outcomes.
	Meet daily and weekly call volume and conversion targets.
	Share customer insights and performance updates with Growth, Marketing, Data, and Operations teams.


Requirements
You're perfect for this role if you have:


	A minimum of a Diploma or Bachelor's degree in any field.
	Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.
	A results-oriented and commercially minded approach.
	Comfort working with targets and performance KPIs.
	Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
	Strong attention to detail and record-keeping skills.


We'll be extra impressed if you:


	Have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Experience in telesales, sales, customer service, or a similar role.
	Have experience using CRM or customer engagement tools.
	Have prior exposure to startup environments.


Click here to apply online

 

2.) Enterprise Sales Manager

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos (Hybrid)
Job Type: Full-time

Job Description


	As an Enterprise Sales Manager, you will drive Chowdeck's growth engine by building relationships with prospective clients and turning them into happy Chowdeck vendors.
	You will handle the full sales cycle for small, medium and large sized vendors, own the relationship with merchants instrumental to Chowdeck's future growth, and work to increase market share and adoption of Chowdeck within our target sector.
	This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Lagos. You will report directly to the Head of Sales and Partnerships.


Responsibilities
In this role you'll be required to:


	Manage a full sales cycle from lead identification and/or assignment to close, for small, medium and large sized vendors and businesses.
	Receive inbound sales requests, qualify and close them, working closely with the vendor management and support teams to convert these requests.
	Own a named account list and develop outbound plans for creating, nurturing, winning and expanding business within your target sectors.
	Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and operational teams both within and outside Chowdeck.
	Identify new business opportunities and craft solutions across multiple products to meet key vendor partner requirements.
	Drive sales engagements via phone and online, sustaining focused conversations to achieve clear objectives.
	Build trust and credibility with prospects by providing accurate information and guidance regarding Chowdeck's products and capabilities.


Requirements
You're perfect for the role if you:


	Have 5+ years of sales experience, including telesales, preferably at a Foodtech or Logistics company in Lagos, with a track record of top performance.
	Are able to engage in business-level conversations and comfortable having entry-level technical conversations at multiple levels of an organisation.
	Have a strong understanding of the buyer journey and can lead consultative, single-stakeholder deals.
	Possess strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders.
	Have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Are able to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment.
	Have a strong interest in technology and enjoy working on products that require deep product knowledge.
	Currently live in Lagos.


Remuneration
Beyond the paycheck, Chowdeck employees get:


	Competitive salary
	Full medical coverage
	MacBook Pro for your work
	Housing assistance
	Lunch allowance
	A team of smart, kind colleagues invested in your growth


Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Sales Associate

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos (Hybrid)

Job Description


	As a Sales Associate at Chowdeck, you will be on the ground identifying and onboarding new vendor partners onto the platform.
	You will be the face of Chowdeck in the field, pitching our value proposition to business owners, managing the onboarding process from first contact to going live, and building the vendor relationships that drive our growth.
	This is a field-based role based in Lagos.


Responsibilities
In this role, you'll be required to:


	Identify and approach potential vendors: restaurants, food businesses, and retail partners for onboarding onto Chowdeck.
	Pitch Chowdeck's value proposition clearly and confidently to business owners.
	Manage the onboarding process from first contact to going live on the platform.
	Meet weekly and monthly vendor acquisition targets.
	Build and maintain relationships with onboarded vendors to ensure retention and satisfaction.
	Gather and report market intelligence on competitor activity, pricing, and vendor pain points.
	Represent Chowdeck professionally at all times, in the field and in vendor meetings.


Requirements
You're perfect for the role if you:


	Have 0–2 years of sales, business development, or field experience; fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
	Have strong verbal communication skills and can explain things clearly and simply.
	Are comfortable in a target-driven, field-based role and resilient enough to handle rejection and take feedback well.
	Are based in Lagos and willing to travel within your assigned territory.
	Have a smartphone and are comfortable using basic apps and tools for reporting.


Remuneration
Beyond the paycheck, Chowdeck employees get:


	Competitive base pay and commission on vendor onboarding
	Full medical coverage
	Training and career growth within Chowdeck's Sales & Partnerships team
	A team of smart, kind colleagues invested in your growth
